paragraphs: Einini Bar Nachshon. See the entry Aninei Bar Sisi.[^1]

notes.text: Einini (עיניני) and Aninei (אנייני) are tentative vocalizations. Nachshon and Sisi are different supplied patronymics; the pointer does not settle their relationship. The supplied target has סיסי, while earlier machine OCR had ביסי.
